chapter_seo_title: Chapter 54 – The Wandering Lord: Multiplying Horror for a Price
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang recovers from his wounds and trains the Fool as a bodyguard. He then discovers the Daoist bell’s hidden power: the Wandering Lord can multiply, but each copy costs three months of his lifespan.
og_description: Li Huowang learns the Wandering Lord has no concept of death—or quantity. By shaking his head, he can spawn a swarm. The price? Ten years of his life for a single squad.
twitter_title: Li Huowang discovers the Wandering Lord can multiply
twitter_description: He trains a bodyguard, tests a broken bell, and learns that summoning a swarm of Wandering Lords would cost a decade of his lifespan.
